messages:
maria-marketing: Quick sync — we need the final changelog URL + the canonical docs link for the launch post. Can engineering confirm the rollout windows? we promised a 'midday' canary to APAC and then broader after 2h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam-eng: Hey Maria — changelog is at https://docs.redwood.inference/release/2026-03-23-changelog (still a draft but stable). Canary plan: 11:00 PDT -> 19:00 UTC for APAC, then progressive to global at 13:00 PDT if no errors. I can paste the rollout snippet if you want the exact times and canary percentages.

maria-marketing: Perfect. Can you drop the exact snippet so we can paste into the blog and the support playbook? Also need the benchmark narrative: which benchmark should we highlight (latency at 256 tokens, cost per 1k tokens on Dedicated)

sam-eng: Sure — snippet below: 
```
rollout:
  canary:
    start: "2026-03-23T11:00:00-07:00"
    regions: ["apac"]
    initial_pct: 5
    step: 10
    promote_after: 2h
  global_promote: "2026-03-23T13:00:00-07:00"
```
Use the changelog link above and the docs: https://docs.redwood.inference/launch/2026-03-optimize which contains the model profiles and quantization notes.

ellie-product: For the benchmark narrative we should call out the 95th percentile latency at 256 tokens on Dedicated (gpu-a100, quantized int8) and the cost delta vs non-quant. Suggest phrasing: "95th pctl latency: 42ms; 3.1x cost reduction vs fp16 baseline on the same workload." happy to draft copy.

maria-marketing: Love that phrasing. Nate, can you slot the webinar CTA to match the post timing? We want the live demo ~90 minutes after global promote so customers can see traffic ramp.

nate-growth: Yup — tentatively the webinar goes live 14:30 PDT. I'll coordinate registration emails and the embed on the post. Do we have a canonical speaker list?

maria-marketing: Speakers: Ellie + Sam + Solutions eng (TBD). I'll finalize names by EOD. Also: who owns the inbound lead routing? We need to ensure high-touch enterprise leads go to AE queue immediately.

jon-sre: Routing wise, support webhook is ready. deploy-bot: deliverable check: changelog published -> trigger webhook to /support/lead-route, tag: "enterprise" if company size > 200. I've tested with staging payload.

maria-marketing: Can you add the webhook URL and example payload to the support playbook? We need Ops to validate routing before publish.

jon-sre: On it. Example payload: `{
  "lead": "ACME Corp",
  "tier": "enterprise",
  "source": "launch_post_2026-03-23"
}`
Will add to the docs in ~30m.

sam-eng: One more ask from eng: if marketing wants the canary window shortened (faster promote) we need to know before 09:30 PDT so SRE can rejigger autoscale thresholds.

maria-marketing: Noted. We'll keep the schedule. Ellie, can you draft the blog intro + bench callout and drop in this thread when ready? Aim for 10:00 PDT publish.

ellie-product: Drafting now, will post a first pass in ~25m.

maria-marketing: Awesome. Final checklist for publish: changelog link ✅ (sam), docs canonical link ✅ (sam), benchmark blurb ✅ (ellie soon), webhook routing ✅ (jon), webinar embed + registration ✅ (nate), speaker list ✅ (maria by EOD). Anything else?

deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled publish hook set for 2026-03-23T10:00:00-07:00. If any file changes after 09:30 PDT please ping #release-war-room.

maria-marketing: Thanks everyone — i'll assemble assets and post the final blog draft here for a quick read. :rocket:
